title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, including its noise and outliers, leading to poor generalization to new data.

title: Strategies to Reduce Variance
text: To reduce model variance, consider strategies that simplify the model or increase the amount of training data.

title: Increase Training Data
text: One way to reduce variance is to increase the amount of training data. This helps the model generalize better.

title: Regularization Techniques
text: Applying regularization techniques like L2 regularization (ridge regression) can help reduce variance by penalizing large coefficients.

title: Simplifying the Model
text: Simplifying the model by reducing the number of features or using a simpler model can also help reduce variance.
